general_description: Linear text classifier (scikit-learn TF-IDF + logistic regression) over anonymised free-text CV summaries. Input: the cv_text field of a screening record. Output: shortlist probability [0,1] plus a binary shortlist recommendation at a recall-oriented threshold. Used exclusively as decision support for human recruiters in Annex III §4 employment screening; no automated rejection is issued by the system.
design_process: Stratified 75/25 train/evaluation split on anonymised screening records; 5-fold cross-validated grid search over the regularisation strength C and TF-IDF n-gram range (1,1)-(1,2); balanced class weights; decision threshold tuned to favour shortlist recall at the cost of precision, reflecting the asymmetric harm of wrongly excluding a qualified applicant.
training_data_description: TalentSift screening corpus — 240 anonymised CV summaries from 2024–2025 recruitment campaigns across office, logistics and engineering vacancy families. One free-text field (cv_text), binary target shortlist (1 = invited to interview). Demographic attributes sex, age_group and nationality are retained solely for Art. 10 §5 non-discrimination monitoring and are never model inputs.
data_governance_measures: Applicant names, birth dates and contact details are stripped before vectorisation; records pseudonymised via salted hashes; access restricted to the model-governance team; annual bias review of the screening corpus against placement outcomes; no enrichment from social-media or data-broker sources.
monitoring_measures: Quarterly fairness re-test (demographic parity and equal opportunity per declared protected attribute); token-distribution drift monitoring over the top-100 TF-IDF mass (alert at PSI > 0.2); recruiter override-rate tracking with monthly review when overrides exceed 15%.
logging_capabilities: Per-screening log: timestamp, hashed applicant_id, vacancy family, model_version, shortlist score, threshold, recommendation, recruiter decision and override flag — retained 5 years per Art. 12.
